action: ACN advises updating all exposed systems urgently (or disconnecting or segmenting them if that is not possible), prioritising the actively exploited CVEs in its bulletin, protecting management interfaces with VPN and MFA, and loading its indicators into SIEM, EDR and similar tools.
date_note: ACN's bulletin BL01/261123/CSIRT-ITA is dated 23 November 2026; the page gives no earlier day.
exec: Italy's CSIRT says it has seen mass compromise campaigns run by autonomous AI-orchestrated agents, which in cases observed directly compromised a large number of systems within hours.
plain: Italy's national cyber agency says it has detected mass hacking campaigns run by autonomous AI agents that automate each attack step. In cases it observed directly, a large number of systems fell within hours.
summary: Italy's CSIRT (ACN) says it detected, in the national context, mass compromise campaigns run by autonomous agents orchestrated with AI. According to ACN the agents automate reconnaissance, vulnerability discovery, exploitation, lateral movement and persistence. In cases observed directly, ACN says a large number of systems were compromised within hours. It names the tools ARTEX, CyberStrikeAI, DeepSeek Harness and PentAGI.
title: Italy's ACN reports mass compromise campaigns run by autonomous AI agents

validation.note: ACN's own bulletin read in full (primary). No second publisher read for the findings.
